FINAL REPORT (rebar-debug):
- Problem: PreToolUse:Bash hook silently failed (exit 127) from any cwd without scripts/, dropping the Serena navigation guidance.
- Root cause: relative command path in .claude/settings.json (line 12) resolved against the shell's cwd at hook time, not the project root.
- Proof: runtime repro from .tickets-tracker (exit 127, exact reported error); same envelope via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR-anchored command succeeded from .tickets-tracker and $HOME — discriminating path-resolution from missing-file/script-bug alternatives.
- Test: tests/unit/test_serena_grep_reminder_hook.py::test_no_hook_command_uses_a_relative_path and ::test_hook_command_resolves_from_a_foreign_cwd — both seen RED first for the right reason; mutation check (relative path restored) returned both to RED.
- Fix: command anchored as "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py. Merged: Gerrit change 1357, commit ddb6f735e4ef171688e17669fe04183d3a2a10f5 on main.
- Scope & safety: config + tests only; no rebar runtime change; no new dependency; no test weakened (one stale docstring corrected); restores documented hook behavior.
- Siblings: none — .claude/settings.json has exactly one hook entry; no other tracked config executes hook commands. The static guard test covers any future hook entry in the file.
- Replication: configured command run from .tickets-tracker with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set emits the reminder JSON, exit 0.
- Residual risk: hooks in untracked operator-local .claude/settings.local.json are outside the guard test's reach — accepted (operator-local by design, not shareable/testable from the repo).
